name: DeleteTask

parameters.help_en: The data retention policy for resources. If this parameter is not specified, it indicates that the deletion is not confirmed. If the node has resources or the resource status is unknown, the API returns a confirmation fault. If you set this parameter to RETAIN, only the node management record is deleted and the cloud resources are retained
parameters.help_zh: 资源保留策略。不传表示未确认；当任务存在资源或资源状态未知时，接口返回确认错误。传 RETAIN 表示仅删除任务管理记录并保留云资源
parameters.name: resource_retention_policy
